## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` – new feature
- [ ] `fix` – bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` – code restructure without behaviour change
- [ ] `test` – new or updated tests
- [ ] `ci` – CI/CD changes
- [ ] `docs` – documentation only
- [ ] `chore` – dependency bump, config tweak

## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] `make lint` passes locally
- [ ] `make test` passes locally with no skipped tests
- [ ] All acceptance criteria for this phase are met (see PROJECT_SPEC.md)
- [ ] New logic has a comment explaining *why* (not just *what*)
- [ ] No secrets, large data files, or `.env` committed
- [ ] `docs/DECISIONS.md` updated if a non-obvious choice was made
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `ci:` …)
